pictures.name: JS1-Young-Jung
pictures.prompt: Switzerland, 1890s: a young man of about twenty with short dark hair, small round glasses and a dark wool suit sits on the edge of a narrow bed in a modest student room under the eaves, waking from a dream, eyes wide and thoughtful. A candle on the nightstand, books stacked, a window to dark mountains. Warm candlelight, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
